basis: Amyloid damages cerebral vessel walls, causing hemorrhages, strokes and progressive neurologic deterioration.
Inherited organic acid metabolism disorders; neurologic injury varies across this broad group and is not established in most patients across subtypes.
Acute myeloid leukemia is a malignant disease of myeloid blood cells and bone marrow.
Acute follicular inflammation of the conjunctiva; an infectious cause is not established for this concept.
Hereditary spastic ataxia with peripheral neuropathy; optic atrophy affects 9/17 assessed patients (~53%).
Autoimmune erosive synovitis defines RA; clinically significant lung disease and vasculitis are minority, separately diagnosed manifestations.
A psychiatric behavioral disorder without defined damage to an organ axis.
Staphylococcal infection directly causes necrotizing pneumonia; hypotension and leukocyte changes do not establish additional organ damage.
Inherited demyelination of peripheral motor and sensory nerves; weakness and secondary deformities do not establish a separate primary muscle disorder.
Progressive cerebellar degeneration with ataxia and other neurologic deficits; nystagmus and abnormal pursuit reflect central dysfunction.
Cerebral vascular amyloid causes hemorrhagic strokes and dementia in 80-99%; dysphagia reflects neurologic dysfunction.
Lysosomal storage disease defined by progressive neurodegeneration, epilepsy and vision loss from retinal degeneration.
Ingested preformed toxin blocks neuromuscular and autonomic transmission; this form is intoxication. Respiratory weakness does not establish lung damage.
Hereditary multinodular enlargement of the thyroid, an endocrine gland.
Benign epithelial neoplasm arising in maxillary sinus respiratory mucosa; sinuses belong to the pulmonary axis.
Defined by abnormal teeth and sensorineural hearing loss; ocular malformations occur in only 5-29%. Facial morphology alone does not establish skeletal damage.
Benign ovarian epithelial neoplasm; reproductive tumour origin has no axis, and endocrine dysfunction is not defining.
Primary familial brain calcification affecting basal ganglia and related CNS structures; no systemic metabolic disorder is established.
Recurrent spontaneous pregnancy loss is an obstetric and reproductive condition outside the axes.
CNS hypomyelination defines PMD. Visual impairment is reported in 80-99%, but may be central; optic atrophy in one assessed patient does not establish common ocular damage.
Congenital absence or cystic malformation of the pericardium.
LPIN1-related metabolic disease causes recurrent skeletal muscle breakdown; acute kidney injury is a separate complication with no qualifying frequency supplied.
Persistent nocturnal urinary incontinence defines a urinary continence disorder; the renal axis includes bladder function.
Acquired abnormality of erythrocyte hemoglobin; hypoxia alone does not establish direct damage to additional organs.
Carcinoma originates in breast tissue, outside the axes; cartilaginous or osseous differentiation does not make this a skeletal primary tumour.
